content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not weigh a live pressed link against the pressing side's own chain; it records that the pressed curse limb was dropped and no live link remains.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"none","why":"The judge does not use the retired stating-verse test or weigh verses individually; it disposes of C4 because the pressed curse limb was dropped, leaving no live link."}
